in_marathi.name: Eklavya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eklavya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is perfected in the art of war and is a loyal disciple.

vedic_reference.note: Eklavya was a prince in Mahabharata who was a skilled warrior, despite not having formal education from a guru. He learned archery by observing Drona from a distance.
